compactRecord.rs: The end of the road. Standing on the limestone bluffs at Hedo, with Yanbaru's primeval forest behind you and the East China Sea ahead, feels like the edge of Japan — because it is.
compactRecord.td: Northernmost cape of Okinawa Honto, where cliffs of uplifted coral limestone face the open East China Sea — Yoron-jima visible on clear days. The cape sits inside Yanbaru National Park (UNESCO Natural World Heritage 2021), 17,300 ha of subtropical ev
